title: Treasury maintains R$ 2.12 diesel subsidy
subtitle: Order published in an extra edition of the Official Gazette ensures the benefit continues
excerpt: The Treasury ensures the R$ 2.12 diesel subsidy remains in place through an order published in an extra edition of the Official Gazette.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Friday (the 25th), the Treasury published, in an extra edition of the Official Gazette of the Union, an order that guarantees the continuation of the R$ 2.12 per litre diesel subsidy.

The measure keeps the fiscal benefit granted to the fuel, ensuring that the final price to consumers continues to reflect the government's support.

The subsidy, set at R$ 2.12 per litre, remains in force from the publication of the order, with no changes to the previously established terms.

With information from Agência Brasil.
